title: ETSI TS 119 602 V1.1.1 - List of Trusted Entities (LoTE), JSON binding (generated)
description: Generated by lote_schema_generator/gen_json.py from explicit/model/lote_model_explicit.json (names: current). Do not edit; change the model or the generator.
$comment: Requirements JSON Schema cannot express, to be enforced by a business-rules layer: 6.4.0 TrustedEntitiesList is present exactly when one or more entities are or were approved. 6.8.0 The list is signed with an AdES digital signature at conformance level baseline B, within the list (Signature component) or encapsulating it. 6.8.0 The signing certificate's C and O attributes match SchemeTerritory and one SchemeOperatorName value. 6.3.2 LoTESequenceNumber starts at 1 and increases with every release. 6.3.15 NextUpdate (when not null) lies after ListIssueDateTime. 6.4.4 ServiceHistory instances are in descending order of status change date-time. 6.6.5 StatusStartingTime of a new current status is not before the list's (re)issuance. 6.6.3.0 A PKI-based service identity contains an X509Certificate or an X509SKI (6.6.0 says: at least one X509Certificate).

LoTE.description: Clause 5, p. 11: "There shall be only one occurrence of the first two and last components"

LoTETag.description: Clause 6.2, p. 15: "The LoTETag component shall be a character string which indicates that the data structure is a LoTE." Required in both bindings (clause 5: exactly one tag). Any URI is accepted: the text registers no Tag URI value (etsi_defects.md #20). The Annex A JSON schema has no tag property; the text prevails (A.1).

NonNegativeInteger.description: Integer >= 0 (a duration; interpretation 1). Clause 6.3.12, p. 22: "When the value of this integer is set to '65535', this signifies that historical information provided in the list of trusted entities shall never be removed."

URI.description: URI per IETF RFC 3986, non-empty. Clause 6.1.2, p. 14: "implementers shall use general syntax as specified by IETF RFC 3986"

URIList.description: Non-empty sequence of URIs. Clause 6.3.16, p. 24: "The DistributionPoints component shall contain a non-empty sequence of URIs."

DateTime.description: ISO 8601 UTC date-time: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ, no fraction. Clause 6.1.3, p. 14: "minute, second (without decimal fraction) and the UTC designator "Z""

PlainText.description: Non-empty string without control, private-use or tag characters and without a UCS signature (Annex B.2). Clause B.2, p. 42: "control characters such as TAB, CR, LF shall not be present"

LanguageTag.description: IETF RFC 5646 tag, primary subtag in lower case (interpretation 5). Clause 6.1.4, p. 14: "Each multilingual character string shall consist of two parts: a tag, conformant to IETF RFC 5646 [11] and in lower case"

MultiLangString.description: One language-tagged plain-text string. Clause 6.1.4, p. 14: "Each multilingual character string shall consist of two parts: a tag, conformant to IETF RFC 5646 [11] and in lower case"

MultiLangURI.description: One language-tagged URI (multilingual pointer). Clause 6.1.4, p. 14: "A multilingual pointer shall be a URI that identifies a resource expressed in a particular language."

MultiLangStrings.description: Non-empty sequence of multilang-text with at least one 'en' entry. Clause 6.1.4, p. 14: "Lists of trusted entities shall be issued supporting at least the UK English language"

MultiLangURIs.description: Non-empty sequence of multilang-uri with at least one 'en' entry. Clause 6.1.4, p. 14: "Lists of trusted entities shall be issued supporting at least the UK English language"

SchemeNameStrings.description: multilang-texts whose values have the form 'CC:name'. Clause 6.3.6, p. 20: "The SchemeName component specifies the name under which the scheme operates."

ElectronicAddress.description: multilang-uris containing a mailto: URI and a web-site (http/https) URI; tel: optional. Clause 6.3.5.2, p. 19: "mandatorily, an e-mail address as a URI"

CountryCode.description: Upper-case country/territory code per 6.1.5 a), b) or c); GB and GR excluded. Clause 6.1.5, p. 15: "All fields carrying Country Codes values, denoted by "CC", shall be in capital letters"

CountryCodeA.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code with UK for GB, EL for GR, plus EU (6.1.5 a only). Clause 6.3.5.1, p. 19: "The Country element, which shall be a two-character code in accordance with clause 6.1.5 (a)."

MimeType.description: MIME type 'type/subtype'. Clause 6.3.13, p. 23: "Scheme territory, as defined in clause 6.3.10; and Mime type."

Base64.description: Base64 (RFC 4648) without line breaks. Clause 6.6.3.1, p. 34: "The X509Certificate component shall be a Base64 string."

NonEmptyString.description: Non-empty string. Clause 6.6.3.2, p. 34: "The X509SubjectName component shall be a string."

TypedURI.description: URI optionally qualified by a service type URI. Clause 6.6.7, p. 36: "The ServiceSupplyPoints component shall be a non-empty sequence of URIs, each such URI being optionally"

Open.description: Format left open by the text; syntax-specific. Clause 6.6.3.3, p. 34: "The format of the PublicKeyValue component is left open and is syntax-specific."

Signature.description: AdES signature; syntax-specific (XAdES in XML, JAdES in JSON). Clause 6.8.0, p. 38: "If the AdES digital signature is present within the LoTE itself, it shall be provided through the Signature component"

Extension.description: Non-empty sequence of extensions whose format is left open. Clause 6.3.17, p. 24: "Each extension shall have an indication of its criticality."
